name: Walt Disney World Swan
insider_take: This iconic swan-topped resort sits right in the heart of Disney magic, offering Westin luxury with unparalleled theme park access.
whats_special: The hotel features stunning 47-foot-tall swan statues designed by renowned architect Michael Graves and offers exclusive Disney perks like Early Theme Park Entry and complimentary Disney transportation. Its prime location between Epcot and Hollywood Studios means you can walk to both parks in under 15 minutes.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 7-12 facing Epcot for spectacular fireworks views from your balcony – you'll get front-row seats to the nightly shows without the crowds.
dont_miss: The resort's acclaimed Il Mulino New York Trattoria for authentic Italian cuisine and the relaxing grotto pool with its hidden cave and waterslide. Take advantage of the resort boat transportation across Crescent Lake for a magical approach to the parks.
pros: Prime Disney World location with walking distance to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios
Complimentary Disney transportation including boats, buses, and monorail access
Multiple dining options including signature restaurants and character dining
Westin luxury amenities with Heavenly Beds and resort-style pools
cons: Large resort size can feel crowded during peak Disney seasons
Premium pricing due to Disney World location
